reported.title: Incorrect Level Measurement Scaling
reported.description: The level measurement is incorrectly scaled; the conversion from raw analog value to centimeters uses a constant of 5000.0f, which does not match the 10 mV/cm scaling. It should be adjusted to reflect the correct scaling based on the 10 mV/cm specification.

reported.title: Missing Timing for Motor Shutdown
reported.description: The motor D10 may not turn off within 600 ms after the level drops below 20.0 cm, as there is no timing mechanism implemented to enforce this requirement.

judge_input.spec:
- Level probe on A0 at 10 mV/cm; fill valve on D9; drum motor on D10; reset on D4 (pull-up).
- States: IDLE (both outputs OFF), FILL (valve D9 HIGH until level >= 25.0 cm), RUN (motor D10 HIGH while level stays >= 20.0 cm), then IDLE.
- Leave RUN and return to IDLE when level drops below 20.0 cm; motor D10 must go LOW within 600 ms.
- Enter FILL from IDLE when level is below 10.0 cm.
- Holding D4 LOW forces IDLE immediately.
- Print `laundry st=<0|1|2> cm=<n>` every 1000 ms.
